messages:
alex: Quick sync: scheduling a rolling NIC rebind + kernel soft-restart in az3 on 2026-03-24 14:00 UTC. Affects racks r-az3-20..r-az3-24 across pools meridian-7 and meridian-8. ETA ~25-35m per rack. Need backfill strategy and cost OK.

maria: ACK. I'll prepare canaries and update autoscaler thresholds. What's the preferred canary order?

alex: Start with meridian-7 r-20, then r-21, finish meridian-8. Keep canary VM/containers pinned. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/az3/az3-nic-rebind-v2 (internal).

devon: Heads-up: meridian-8 currently has active long GPU training for SkylineAI and NovaML. Skyline's run finishes ~15:30 UTC, NovaML has flexible window. We can swap racks if needed.

alex: Option: we stagger meridian-7 earlier at 14:00, delay meridian-8 to 15:40 to avoid interference. Thoughts?

nina: Delay sounds safer. Also recommend pre-warming KV and model caches and running the perf probe for 128-token prompts. We saw a 350ms tail last time on cold starts.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: az3-kernel-nic-rebind-20260324 - scheduled 2026-03-24T14:00:00Z. Subscribers: eng-infra, customer-success, oncall.

billing-bot: Note: enabling spare-pool-burst for cross-pool backfill estimated incremental cost ~ $1,250 for 2h if used. Approve? Reply with `approve-cost` to auto-grant.

maria: Preliminary capacity: meridian-7 GPUs total=120, reserved=45, avg-util=36%, headroom ~26 GPUs. meridian-8 GPUs total=140, reserved=50, avg-util=60%, headroom ~14 GPUs.

devon: 14 GPUs headroom is small. If Skyline spikes, we'll risk throttles. Recommend sashimi-migration (move some non-latency tenants to spare-pool-2) before starting. That takes ~10m.

alex: Good call. @maria can you trigger migration of low-priority jobs off meridian-8 by 14:50 and pre-seed spare pool?

maria: On it. Migration plan: `./tools/migrate_tenants --from meridian-8 --to spare-pool-2 --filter lowprio --max-parallel 10`. Will monitor job evictions.

nina: After each rack drain, I'll run perf probe: ```bash
./tools/probe_perf --pool meridian-8 --tokens 128 --qps 5 --duration 60
``` Watch 95th pct latency and error rate.

devon: Also add note to tenants: SkylineAI (contact: skyline-oncall) and NovaML (contact: nova-eng) to avoid large epoch starts 15:00-16:30. I'll ping them.

alex: Billing: @billing-bot please auto-approve temp burst if headroom <20 GPUs during operation. We'll bear the cost.

billing-bot: Received. Auto-approval rule added for this maintenance window. Cost notification will be posted to #finops after.

oncall-bot: Escalation rule set: if error rate increase >2.5% sustained for 8m OR 95th latency jumps >500ms, page oncall.

alex: Important ops steps (short): 1) cordon + drain rack, 2) rebind NIC + soft-restart kernel module, 3) uncordon, 4) pre-seed KV/model cache, 5) run perf probe, 6) mark rack DONE. Keep 5m cool-off between racks.

maria: Commands I'll run during ops: ```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-r-az3-20
kubectl drain gpu-node-r-az3-20 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
./tools/attach_nic --node r-az3-20 --mode rebind
sleep 30
./tools/run_kmod_reload --node r-az3-20
./tools/prime_kv_cache --pool meridian-7 --seq 128 --warm=30
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-r-az3-20
```

nina: I'll post probe results in thread after each rack. If probe fails, we'll roll back NIC bind and requeue.

devon: Edge case: PVs with local SSD mounts sometimes block drain. Add `--delete-local-data` but if eviction fails, we fallback to live-migrate small tenants.

alex: Final call: meridian-7 start 14:00 UTC, meridian-8 start 15:40 UTC, migration of low-prio jobs starts 14:50, spare-pool-2 as backfill, temp-burst auto-approve. I'll send tenant comms and update #customer-success. If no objections in 20m I'll lock schedule. :white_check_mark:
